run_dqn_atari: run a DQN agent on an Atari environment like Pong with configurable number of steps
build_dqn_experiment_config: build a DQN experiment config with Atari environment, Q-learning loss, and network factory
configure_dqn_agent: configure a DQN agent with discount rate, epsilon, learning rate, and replay buffer sizes
run_distributed_dqn: run a distributed DQN experiment with multiple actors using LaunchPad
create_qlearning_loss: create a Q-learning loss function with configurable discount and max absolute reward
